relationships.subject: Alpha-bungarotoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of α-Bgtx (1.0 μg/kg) not only inhibited the effect of 2 Hz EA on mechanical hypersensitivity but also ameliorated the down-regulation of p-JAK2, p-STAT3 and IL-6 expression induced by 2 Hz EA.

key_findings: 2 Hz EA reduced SNI-induced mechanical hypersensitivity and spinal p-JAK2, p-STAT3 and IL-6.
The α7nAChR antagonist α-Bgtx reversed both the analgesic effect and the JAK2/STAT3 suppression.
